services.name: Valeting & detailing
services.note: Starting prices for a standard car in reasonable condition. Size and condition move the price.

items.detail: Up to 3 hours, every 2-4 weeks. A deep clean is usually needed first.
Up to 4 hours, inside and out, finished with a ceramic sealant.
Up to 5 hours. Full Valet plus seats shampooed or leather balmed, steam clean, tar and iron removal.
Up to 10 hours. Deep clean, gloss-enhancing machine polish and 12-month Fusso wax.
Exterior detail, interior deep clean, engine bay, wheels and tyres, listing photos.

services.name: Ceramic coatings
services.note: Added on top of a detail. Every package includes decontamination and a Stage 1 machine polish. Inc VAT.

items.detail: Up to 2 years. Enhanced gloss, water beading, UV protection.
Up to 5 years. Mirror finish, extreme water and dirt repellency.
Up to 7 years. Paintwork, wheels and exterior surfaces.
Up to 7 years or about 45,000 miles. Glass polished and decontaminated first.
Brake dust rinses off.
Applied to seats, ideal while they are new.

services.name: Add-ons & specialist
services.note: Priced for a standard car and added to any valet or detail.

items.detail: Pair, sealed with a 1-year ceramic coating. 45-90 minutes.

services.name: Paint correction
services.note: Always quoted after seeing the paint. Stage 1 gloss enhancement is part of the Make Over.

items.detail: Two-stage correction, quoted after inspection.
3-6 hours at your home.
Full correction on neglected paint.

services.name: Fleet (per vehicle)
services.note: Vans, pickups and company cars on site, scheduled around downtime. Two or more vehicles at one address works out cheaper per vehicle.

items.detail: Safe exterior wash, wheels, tyres, quick interior.
Everything in Basic plus paint decontamination and interior deep clean.
Presentation standard.

services.name: Maintenance plans
services.note: Needs a deep clean or detail first (from £135). A four-month term is 16 weekly, 8 fortnightly or 4 monthly visits. 5% off contracted, 10% off paid in full.

items.detail: Safe wash, alloys, drying, sealant.
Adds interior vacuum and wipe-down.
